fixed_family.parameter: K>=0 is one fixed constant chosen before the input
fixed_family.rule: Eliminate variable v by exact Davis-Putnam whenever p(v)*q(v) <= p(v)+q(v)+K.
fixed_family.tie_break: fixed deterministic order among eligible variables

polynomial_phase_theorem.statement: For every fixed K, the full legal reduction phase has polynomial charged work and polynomial live state.
proof: One elimination removes p+q pivot clauses and creates at most p*q non-tautological resolvents.
The rule implies net clause increase <= K per elimination.
At most n_0 variables are eliminated, so the clause count is at most m_0+K*n_0.
Every simple clause has length at most n_0, hence literal storage is O((m_0+K*n_0)*n_0), polynomial because K is fixed.
Each elimination enumerates only polynomially many pivot pairs relative to this polynomial state; at most n_0 eliminations occur.

universal_progress_barrier.published_source: Andreas Darmann and Janosch Doecker, On simplified NP-complete variants of Monotone 3-Sat, Discrete Applied Mathematics 292 (2021), 45-58, DOI 10.1016/j.dam.2020.12.010.
universal_progress_barrier.published_statement_used: For every fixed k>=2, Monotone 3-Sat is NP-complete even when every variable appears exactly k times positively and exactly k times negatively.
universal_progress_barrier.choice_for_any_fixed_K: Choose a fixed integer k>=2 such that k^2>2k+K; such a k always exists.
universal_progress_barrier.effect: On every Monotone 3-Sat-(k,k) instance, p=q=k and p*q=k^2>2k+K=p+q+K, so the K-budget reducer has no legal first move.
universal_progress_barrier.conclusion: For every fixed constant K, there is an NP-complete regular exact-3-CNF class entirely contained in the reducer's fixed-point set.
universal_progress_barrier.scope: This proves failure of universal progress for this fixed-budget DP architecture. It does not prove that the fixed-point class is outside P and does not imply P!=NP.

next_admissible_math.question: A successor must escape fixed additive CNF-elimination budgets: can one prove a polynomial exact transition on the regular Monotone 3-Sat-(k,k) cores using a genuinely different invariant, with charged state/work and polynomial terminal evaluation?
forbidden: incrementing K by another fixed constant
